questions.q: What does lesson 1 say to do before judging the world?
a: Take responsibility for your own life
questions.why: Lesson 1 says to focus on keeping your own house clean first.

questions.q: Which option did Tolstoy choose among his four responses to life's unfairness?
a: Holding on and struggling despite everything
questions.why: The summary says Tolstoy chose to keep struggling on.

questions.q: How does lesson 2 say you should treat yourself?
a: Like a loved one you're responsible for
Like a rival you must beat
Like a customer you must please
questions.why: Lesson 2 advises caring for yourself as you would for someone you love.

questions.q: What example of self-neglect does the summary give?
questions.why: It notes over a third of people don't take medicine they're prescribed.

questions.q: According to lesson 3, what is sacrifice really about?
questions.why: Lesson 3 says sacrifice defers rewards until you get something more whole.
